name: tts-cpp
description: Text-to-speech inference in pure C++/ggml. Ships Resemble Chatterbox (Turbo + Multilingual variants) and Supertonic engines under a unified Engine API. Sourced from qvac-ext-lib-whisper.cpp's tts-cpp/ subfolder. This pin adds QVAC-16579 LavaSR neural speech enhancement (PR #68): an opt-in CPU/GGML post-process that bandwidth-extends synthesized PCM to 48 kHz via the LavaSR Vocos enhancer (ConvNeXt backbone + ISTFT spec head) converted to a single GGUF — new public tts_cpp::lavasr::Enhancer API, DSP core (Lanczos resampler, STFT/ISTFT, Slaney mel, FastLR merge), f32+f16 GGUF loader, and onnxruntime-parity tests; the denoiser stage is a planned follow-up; fully backward compatible. INTERIM fork pin (167c9406) until PR #68 merges. Layered on the prior 46921668 pin (PR #65, QVAC-19557 S3TokenizerV2 host-mirror elimination). Consumes the ggml-speech port.
